frontend-design.apply: Choose a distinctive visual direction before writing UI code.
web: Derive the hero composition from the product's strongest visible proof. Establish an alignment grid, a type hierarchy, and one intentional focal point before styling supporting sections.
Write two plausible visual directions and choose the more product-specific one. Carry its typography, spacing, and color decisions into the actual component styles.
frontend-design.check: Point to the implemented hero, the visible product proof, and one deliberate departure from the obvious template.
ios: Use the most useful screen state as the starting point. Decide the visual hierarchy and one product-specific focal point, then apply them to the native layout.
Turn reference observations into an original color and type system. Keep native navigation, input and safe areas familiar.

ui-ux-pro-max.apply: Translate the brief into a small consistent design system.
web: Define reusable tokens for surface, foreground, accent, type, spacing and interaction states. Resolve contrast and density before choosing ornamental details.
Design the primary journey and include useful empty, loading, error and success states wherever the product actually needs them.
ios: Use semantic colors, system text styles and native controls. Test the primary journey at larger Dynamic Type sizes.
Keep actionable states, hit areas and spacing consistent with the app's existing navigation and components.
ui-ux-pro-max.check: Identify the tokens and interaction states implemented in code. Treat any unverified platform behavior as pending.

taste-skill.apply: Refine the copy, composition and rhythm around what the product does.
web: Name the product and user outcome in plain language. Give each section one purpose and remove claims or badges without evidence.
Use shared alignment and varied section density. Reserve motion for a meaningful entrance, transition or input response and provide a reduced-motion path.
taste-skill.check: Verify the landing reads in order on a narrow viewport and the primary action leads somewhere useful.
ios: Make the empty, drafting and submitted states read clearly in the user’s language. Give each view one primary purpose.
Keep visual rhythm consistent across the timeline and composer. Use motion only for state changes that benefit from it and honor Reduce Motion.

impeccable.apply: Inspect the actual rendered result and fix the most consequential problem.
web: Decide whether the page persuades, supports a task, or serves reading. Judge the hierarchy, typography, and interaction states against that goal in the actual captures.
Record a visible issue, its user impact and precise location. Apply a targeted fix and inspect a fresh capture under the same conditions.
ios: Inspect a simulator or device capture of the primary state and one stress state, such as larger type. Check layout priority, navigation and touch targets.
Fix the most consequential visible problem and rerun the same state. Leave the visual check pending when a capture is unavailable.
impeccable.check: Link the actual evidence and one correction or pass condition per inspected state.

web-accessibility.apply: Implement and verify keyboard and screen-reader access to the primary flow.
web: Use native elements and visible labels. Ensure meaningful accessible names, logical Tab order, visible focus, and announcements for relevant state changes.
Exercise the primary flow by keyboard. Verify measured contrast, navigation landmarks, target size and reduced-motion behavior where applicable.
web-accessibility.check: Record keyboard steps and reported outcomes. Distinguish spot checks from a full accessibility audit.

web-design-guidelines.apply: Find reproducible web UI defects and make them actionable.
web: Inspect narrow and wide layouts, long content, focus, forms, loading and error recovery as applicable. Exercise links, filters and buttons in the rendered page.
Give each confirmed finding a location, reproduction step, impact and targeted fix. Recheck after changes and state which conditions remain unmeasured.
web-design-guidelines.check: Record viewport sizes, interaction exercised, overflow, and any console errors.

shadcn.apply: Reuse the project's installed shadcn primitives and conventions.
web: Inspect components.json, existing UI imports and installed dependencies. Determine which primitive implementation the project uses before composing a control.
Use the project’s shadcn Button for suitable buttons and its Textarea or Dialog when appropriate. Respect existing variants and tokens, and verify keyboard behavior.
shadcn.check: Point to an existing imported primitive or explain why a new one is needed.

superpowers.apply: Verify behavior with fresh evidence before claiming completion.
web: For a defect, capture a reproducible failing case and trace its cause before patching. Exercise the same case after the patch.
Run relevant existing checks and inspect current output. Report the exact evidence and name any checks that could not run.
ios: For a defect, reproduce the exact navigation or state on the target device or simulator before patching when available.
Run relevant build and interaction checks and confirm the output. Distinguish source inspection from a native execution.
superpowers.check: Report the executed check, result and any specific limitation.

heroui.apply: Use verified HeroUI primitives for React UI.
web: Install the pinned React and styles packages. Read the matching local component documentation.
heroui.check: Verify package versions, imports, browser components, and keyboard interaction.

thesvg.apply: Render real brand marks from the approved local catalogue.
web: Declare brand slugs, retrieve each SVG, and render the exact asset with an accessible name.
thesvg.check: Verify SHA-256 on disk and in Chromium, or record why the brief needs no third-party marks.
